name: Maserati 4CL
description:
4CL: 4 cyl in-line, 78 * 78mm = 1491cc, 4 valves/cyl, twin overhead camshafts, Roots supercharger, 220 bhp @ 8000 rpm

Design: Ernesto Maserati
Transmission: 4 speed gearbox
Chassis: Box section side members
Suspension: Front: double wishbones, torsion bars, hydraulic dampers Rear: quarter-elliptic leaf springs, hydraulic dampers
Dimensions: Wheelbase: 2500mm, Track: 1250mm, dry weight: 630 kg
Top speed: 250 km/h
Years: 1939-1950

Maserati answered the Alfa 158 with a sixteen-valve four, and then the war came. What the 4CL was really built for turned out to be 1946: the new Grand Prix formula was the old voiturette formula, Maserati would sell one to anybody, and for three seasons the entry list of almost every race in Europe was Alfa Romeo, Alfa Romeo, and then a dozen 4CLs. It won plenty of the races Alfa Corse did not enter.
author: Legion
